correctness.rationale: PASS: Ordinary graph Morse simplices are acyclic partial vertex-edge matches, equivalently rooted edge forests. Exhaustive independent reconstruction from all 18 incidences yields exactly 1,728 faces including the empty face, with 18,126,428,705,450 nonempty faces by dimensions. A face-poset matching in the source fixed pivot order has 831 pairs, critical one vertex plus 64 dimension-four faces; independent reconstruction of all 6,606 Hasse incidences visits all 1,727 nonempty faces in a topological sort, proving acyclicity. Hence X≃vee^64 S^4. Independent signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz enumeration for all 12 automorphisms gives L=(65,1,2,-3,-7,0) for six classes, hence H4 character (64,0,1,-4,-8,-1). Inner products with S3×C2 irreducible characters give multiplicities 3,7,10 and 8,4,11; averaging proves quotient invariant dimension three. The all-face enumeration is genuinely exhaustive, not a sampled finite pattern.

originality.rationale: PASS best-of-knowledge: The same prism Morse complex already has known mod-two H4 rank64 and a stronger nonequivariant integral homotopy equivalence to a wedge of 64 four-spheres. These are fully credited, and no novelty is assigned to the old rank/homotopy conclusion. The new result is the complete nontrivial automorphism character and rational quotient homology; those do not follow from Betti numbers or bare homotopy type. Other equivariant Morse results concern different graphs. A closely related 2020 directed forest complex thesis was inaccessible beyond its abstract and is a material priority risk.
